item.description: Experiment: Atrous spatial filtering 2026-08-18 Commit: 8a67b2d Experimental spatial filtering is implemented using Atrous wavelet filtering. This update is for posterity, as the performance was so terrible that this change is reverted. Atrous filtering works in iterations.
